summary:
Iter16 verifies the server.py → routes/{auth,office,masters,muster,admin_tools}.py extraction (~1280 lines moved out of server.py; server.py now 3033 lines). All 5 new modules are mounted via app.include_router with factory dependency injection (verified at server.py:2843-2865). New regression file /app/backend/tests/test_review_iter16.py exercises every endpoint listed in the review request — 34/34 PASS in 5.75s against the live preview URL. Broader regression run (iter11/12/13/14 + smoke + routes/leaves + routes/reports) = 75/75 PASS in 14s. Combined 109/109 GREEN. Zero route regressions detected.

ROUTE-BY-ROUTE COVERAGE:
• routes/auth.py (8 tests) — POST /auth/login returns {access_token, token_type=bearer, user.role=admin}; GET /auth/me returns admin profile (leave_balance_remaining only set when category!=athlete & opening seeded); /auth/me 401 without token; POST /auth/phone with 9849002111 instant-approves + returns access_token + user.role=admin (admin instant-approve cinch intact); GET /auth/phone/status?device_id=unknown → exactly {status:'unknown'}; GET /admin/devices returns list array (admin), 401 no-token, 403 member-token.
• routes/office.py (5 tests) — GET /office masks twilio.auth_token with bullet chars + has_auth_token flag; PUT /office accepts radius_m/late_grace_minutes update, response echoes the new values, restore after test verified; POST /admin/checkout-reminder/send-now returns {sent: <int>} for admin, 403 for member; GET /changelog returns {markdown: '<non-empty string>'} (no auth required, as designed).
• routes/masters.py — institutions (4): list has member_count per row, POST 403 for member, rename PATCH cascades (verified by re-listing), DELETE on in-use institution rejected with 400/409. Fleets (4): list has athlete_count per row, POST 403 for member, /fleets/assign with non-existent fleet name returns 404 ('Fleet … not in master'), rename PATCH cascades.
• routes/muster.py (5 tests) — GET /muster/athletes?mode=checkin returns athletes[] with already_checked_in flag + check_in_at timestamp (admin sees full roster); ?mode=checkout returns only open-session athletes with already_checked_in forced False; invalid mode → 400; POST /muster/checkin-bulk inserts attendance row on first call and SKIPS on second call with reason 'already checked in' in skipped[]; POST /muster/checkout-bulk closes the open session (cleanup verified).
• routes/admin_tools.py (8 tests) — /admin/summary returns the 5 required int counts (total_members, on_campus, pending_leaves, on_leave_tour, late_today); /admin/preflight returns overall ∈ {ready,warnings,blocked} + exactly 7 checklist items each carrying a 'severity' field; /admin/activity returns {date, timezone, events:[], counts:{}}; /admin/attendance/wipe correctly 401 without token and 403 with member token (NOT actually invoked — destructive); all three reader endpoints 403 for member token.

Did NOT call /api/admin/backup (per review note about ingress timeout) nor /api/admin/attendance/wipe destructive path.
action_items: OPTIONAL: The pre-existing infra-timeout tests test_13_admin_backup_targz + dependent test_14_admin_restore_targz_merge from iter13 remain blocked by the kubernetes ingress on large tar.gz bodies — endpoint is fine locally; consider gating them behind a marker so they don't show as flake.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py modularisation is clean: every extracted router uses a make_router(...) factory accepting callable deps (db, require_admin, get_current_user, helper fns) — no import cycles, no globals leaked. Mount points at server.py:2843-2865 are sequential and easy to scan.

routes/auth.py preserves the trusted-phone cinch + admin self-recovery logic verbatim including the audit trail (last_action / last_action_by / last_action_at) — verified by direct phone-bypass test returning the user object with role=admin.

routes/office.py correctly STRIPS the twilio sub-doc on PUT (line 56) so a partial save from the geofence UI can never blow away SMS credentials. Token masking on GET also intact — confirmed via direct response inspection.

routes/muster.py — the new already_checked_in + check_in_at fields on checkin-mode response surface the data the frontend needs to render greyed-out 'already in @ HH:MM' rows. checkout mode correctly forces already_checked_in=False (avoids stale flag confusion).
routes/admin_tools.py preflight returns exactly 7 items each with a severity field — matches the spec. wipe endpoint correctly admin-gated (401/403 not 200).
Minor: routes/office.py reads CHANGELOG.md from disk on every /api/changelog request. Fine for a small file but consider an LRU cache if it grows large.
Minor: muster.py:62 — full athletes scan (db.users.find({'category':'athlete'}).to_list(2000)) limit hardcoded; at ~133 members today this is fine, but worth a comment noting the cap.

success_rate.frontend: n/a — review_request testing_type was 'backend only(skip frontend)'

test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 (email login). Admin phone bypass: 9849002111 (instant approve).
seed_data_creation: Created and torn-down ephemeral institutions (TEST_iter16_inst_*) and fleets (TEST_iter16_fleet_*) for rename/delete tests. One athlete is briefly checked-in via /muster/checkin-bulk in test_muster_checkin_bulk_double_skipped then checked-out in the cleanup step — DB state restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter16 is GREEN — the modular extraction of auth/office/masters/muster/admin_tools routes is regression-free. Backend pytest suite total: prior 75 (iter11-14, smoke, routes/leaves, routes/reports) + new 34 (test_review_iter16.py) = 109/109 PASS in ~20s combined. The two known pre-existing infra failures (test_13_admin_backup_targz, test_14_admin_restore_targz_merge) were NOT re-run per review_request guidance — ingress proxy still times out on the large tar.gz body, endpoint itself is functional. Next agent: if main agent ships further extractions, copy test_review_iter16.py's factory-pattern tests as a template for testing factored routers via the public ingress.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. One transient test-authoring miss (initial /fleets/assign test used 'athlete_ids' key + empty list, server requires 'member_ids' + non-empty per FleetAssignIn pydantic model; corrected and re-ran).
